name: Reader
author: ClumZeez
description: A minimal ebook reader for the Omarchy bar: a cover-art library, a table of contents that works, pages or scrolling, day or night, and it remembers your place. Offline.

barWidget.description: Read your ebooks from the bar

schema.label: Library folder
schema.description: Where your books are. Leave empty to use ~/Books, ~/Documents/Books or ~/Documents/EPUB.

schema.label: Reading text size
schema.description: In pixels. 0 follows the shell's text size. Also adjustable in the reader with + and -.
